title: Woman Sitting Indoors, 1940s Sepia Snapshot, Home Interior
description: A mid-1940s indoor snapshot of a woman wearing eyeglasses and a collared dress, smiling warmly while seated on a quilt-covered storage bench or trunk. In the foreground is a woven wicker rocking chair. Through the open doorway behind her, an adjacent room is visible featuring a light fixture hanging from the ceiling and an ornate fireplace mantel. This image offers a charming view of mid-century American domestic life.
